The '''Mantellian Separatist Movement''' was an organization formed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in opposition to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], many planets seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to join the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] or pursue independence. The corrupt planetary [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]] of Ord Mantell opted to remain loyal to the Republic. However many on the planet desired the independence of their world. The resulting separatist movement sparked a [[Separatist War|civil war]] on the planet, with the government receiving backing from both the Republic and elements of the criminal underworld.

[[File:Mantellian_Separatists.png|thumb|220px|left|A Mantellian Separatist]]
The Ord Mantell separatists established a network of underground bases from which they launched guerrilla attacks on the Ord Mantell government and Republic targets. The attacks resulted in the destruction of the Ord Mantell landscape and the destabilization of the local governments. A primary base of the separatists was a [[Mount Avilatan|large volcano]]. Located on the island of [[Avilatan]], the heart of the volcano was a [[Separatist stronghold]] used to conduct meetings and organize separatist forces. Separatist leaders often met in the stronghold. Another major base was the island of [[Mannett Point]]. After invading the island, Separatist forces captured large amounts of Republic munitions, and used it against government and Republic forces. Such munitions captured included small arms and rocket launchers.
[[File:Separatist_Stronghold.jpg|thumb|250px|right|The Separatist stronghold]]

The Separatist movement held large portions of the island of Avilatan. Separatist forces fought for control of several villages on the island, including [[Drelliad village|Drelliad]] and [[Talloran village]]s. In addition, the [[Avilatan Badlands]] were a hotly contested area. Separatist forces claimed much control of the Badlands, and led raids against Republic convoys. The Separatists used the Badlands as an ambush point, planting bombs along it.

==Political backing==
{{Quote|After separatist forces were crushed on Ord Mantell, Governor Chornarov secretly offered their leaders and surviving troops asylum on Cademimu.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:MantellianSeparatistsPoster.png|thumb|left|150px||Propaganda poster found in the Talloran village]]
Investigation into the separatist movement's roots revealed that it shared financial backing with the [[Justicars' Brigade]] paramilitary group&mdash;the backers being the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Sith Empire contributed propaganda, munitions, and financial aid to the Separatist cause. The Sith Empire also maintained a [[Imperial Listening Post|Listening Post]] on Ord Mantell. It provided intelligence on Republic movements to the Separatists.

At the end of the [[Separatist War|civil war]], a portion of separatists led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ortol]] moved to [[Cademimu V]]. Cademimu governor [[Chornarov]] declared independence from the Republic, while Ortol and his men helped him take control of the planet and its missile defenses. The action was met with [[Cademimu uprising|resistance]] from Cademimu's population. When the Republic and Empire intervened, most of the separatists were killed along with their commander, General Ortol.<ref name="Cademimu">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Cademimu}}</ref>

By [[3624 BBY]], the separatists were backed by the [[Hidden Chain]], a rogue movement of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who opposed [[Mandalore the Avenger]]'s [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|faction]].<ref name="Nowhere">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Road to Nowhere|[[Port Nowhere]]}}</ref>

==Military==
The separatist military virtually included the whole movement, and was well-organized and equipped, being able to deploy [[armor-piercing missile]]s<ref name="Hit the Ground Running">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hit the Ground Running|Ord Mantell}}</ref> and [[Jammer/Legends|signal jammers]]<ref name="Clearing the Air">{{TORcite|type=general|Clearing the Air|Ord Mantell}}</ref> on the battlefield. It was mostly reliant on infantry militia, sometimes supported by heavy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] units ("liberation droids"). They used various tactics, from mass assault to guerrilla, and didn't hesitate to kill civilians.<ref name="Sniper Hunt">{{TORcite|type=general|Snipe Hunt|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

==Navy==
The separatist movement offered some resistance to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in Ord Mantell space, being able to deploy [[Unidentified freighter class|freighters]] and starfighters. Those nearly ended the career of one of the most fierce [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|soldiers]] of the Republic before it truly started.<ref name="Trooper Intro">[[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]] introduction video</ref>
